long: Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition is a remaster of BioWare's classic 1998 Dungeons & Dragons role-playing game built on the Infinity Engine. Players create a hero, recruit a party, and explore the Sword Coast in a sprawling story of murder and intrigue, using real-time-with-pause AD&D 2nd Edition combat. The Enhanced Edition adds new companions, updated visuals, and the Siege of Dragonspear expansion.
